title: Refuse oversized preparation metadata before publishing a generation
outcome: Refuse oversized preparation metadata before publishing a generation
acceptance: Preparation refuses serialized state.json larger than its 1 MiB reader limit before publishing a generation or candidate, preserving existing progress/output; an owned regression supplies a large capture reason or omission map and verifies the refusal.
Metadata at the supported size remains readable by journal load and the explicit prepared reader, including recovery after opt-out.

completion.summary:
Landed c96b71e on master. publish() serializes preparation metadata and refuses a state.json over the shared 1 MiB STATE_LIMIT before it prunes, stages or writes anything. Every state.json reader (journal load, resume x2, prepared reader x2) uses the same limit. The regressions cover an oversized reason and both omission maps, with progress and output unchanged, and an exact-limit state that stays readable and recoverable after opt-out.
